feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 June 2026 9:02am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 18 June 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this morning. Often a force or two lighter in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain this morning, largely clearing during the afternoon, but with areas of mist and fog patches spreading from the south.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist, then very poor in fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, falling 3 to 5 in all waters Friday evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Rain arriving tomorrow morning, becoming patchier in the evening, then mostly fair overnight. Mist and fog patches persisting throughout this period.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist. Very poor in fog patches.
